project_info.theme: Award-winning Vinamilk Premium Gelato Matcha announcement
project_info.color_palette: Deep forest green, matcha green, caramel brown, cream white

main_subject.detail: Three large scoops of pale matcha gelato stacked in a branded cup on the right side, with glossy caramel-brown syrup dripping over the scoops. On the left are the award badge '2026 WORLD DAIRY INNOVATION AWARDS WINNER', the line 'BEST ICE-CREAM 2026', the main headline 'KEM NGON NHẤT NĂM 2026', and the subline 'PREMIUM GELATO MATCHA'. A Vinamilk 50th anniversary logo sits near the bottom left.
main_subject.style: Premium food advertising poster, minimalist high-contrast studio setup, luxury gelato presentation
